Please answer this question with a number--which of the following best apply to the design in the study: 
        (1) totally fun first (i.e., Entertainment game reappropriated), 
        (2) mostly fun first (i.e., design workshop with disabled stakeholders),
        (3) both fun and utility first (i.e., design workshop with diverse stakeholders), 
        (4) mostly utility first (i.e., primary utilitarian mechanic designed first),
        (5) totally utility first (i.e., made by clinicians or specialists, fun incorporated later)
reasoning: The work is a research project on making GIFs accessible, motivated by accessibility needs of blind Twitter users. The design centers on creating utilitarian accessible alternatives (alt text, source audio, audio description) based on best-practice guidelines and then evaluating them with blind participants. It is not an entertainment game, nor a co-designed playful system; fun/enjoyment is mentioned only as a secondary benefit (more emotive and enjoyable experience) of certain formats. This aligns with a mostly utility-first design where the primary utilitarian mechanism (accessible representations) is designed first, with enjoyment considered later.
